note: Measured by the `embedding-api.yml` C API jobs on GitHub-hosted runners (run 39307687792, all three platforms green). Timings are single samples of a debug build, so they are a trend line, not a budget: `etc/ci/embedding_observability.py` reports the change against them and never fails on it. `screenshot_ms` is deliberately absent: that run measured the metric with the pre-fix timing, which always read 0 because the screenshot is delivered synchronously; the timing was corrected in the same push that added this file, so the next run establishes the first real value. See docs/embedding/OBSERVABILITY.md.
